description: This file is a PHP source file containing classes and functions related to the installation and configuration process of the SuiteCRM application. It includes class definitions for handling localization, layout rendering, error display, and the main installation workflow, as well as procedural code for setup logic.

classes.name: NonDBLocalization
classes.description: Handles localization options unrelated to database, providing methods to generate locale-specific dropdown options.

classes.name: InstallLayout
classes.description: Provides static methods for rendering HTML layout components used during installation, such as select dropdowns and page structures.

classes.name: DisplayErrors
classes.description: Manages temporary display and restoration of PHP error reporting settings.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Main method of InstallLayout class to generate and output the entire installation HTML page based on passed data.

methods.name: getSelect
methods.description: Returns an HTML select element with specified options, default selection, and name.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Sets PHP error reporting to display all errors and stores previous settings to restore later.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores previous PHP error reporting settings saved earlier.
